text:
maria: Quick question — we keep debating how charge aggregation should look for the new billing pipeline. Do we emit token-level events (one event per request with tokens) or ship aggregated charge batches (per-minute/per-route) from the edge?

aj: Token-level gives best fidelity for audits but blows up event count and storage. Aggregated cuts volume but makes attribution and late-arrivals painful.
\kai: Another axis: real-time vs eventual. Real-time per-token lets downstream enforce SLAs, but we can do aggregated streaming with smaller windows and still meet most needs.
sanjay: If we go aggregated, we need deterministic shard keys + monotonic batch ids to avoid duplicates after retries. Also need a canonical request fingerprint for cross-system joins.
maria: Agree. Thinking: emit a compact per-request envelope at ingest (small footprint) + periodic aggregation for billing. Envelope has fingerprint + minimal attribution metadata.
aj: That feels like a good compromise. We can keep raw envelopes for 30 days then archive. Billing runs on aggregates derived from envelopes so audits can re-run if needed.
billing-bot: FYI — current quotas: raw-envelopes retention 14d; archive run weekly. Link: https://go/redwood/billing-retention
kai: Two gotchas: 1) late-arrival corrections — we need a reconciliation job that joins envelopes -> aggregates and emits correction deltas, 2) idempotency: use (tenant, request_fingerprint, ingest_window_start) as composite key.
sanjay: For reconciliation, prefer append-only correction events (negative deltas) rather than rewriting aggregates. Easier for audit trail.
maria: Also want sampling mode for very high-volume tenants — sample envelopes then scale up with on-demand full-fidelity exports if dispute.
aj: Can we fold quantization/rounding rules into the pipeline so billing math is stable across versions? Need a schema field `billing_version`.
sanjay: Yes — include `billing_version` and `aggregation_profile` in envelope. That way rolling upgrades don't silently change dollars.
kai: Example envelope proto: ```
{
  request_fingerprint: "sha256(...)",
  tenant_id: "t-123",
  model_variant: "gpt-xyz-q4",
  tokens_input: 42,
  tokens_output: 128,
  ingest_ts: 1709999999,
  billing_version: "v1.2",
  aggregation_profile: "per_minute"
}
```
maria: Action items: 1) AJ to draft mini-RFC for envelope schema + retention (due Fri), 2) Kai to prototype reconciliation delta emitter, 3) Sanjay to propose shard key and idempotency sketch.
aj: I'll start the RFC and include cost estimates for envelope vs aggregated storage.
kai: I'll throw together a PoC consumer that emits correction deltas for late-arrivals.
sanjay: I'll post shard key doc and a short note on streaming transactional guarantees.
maria: thanks — we'll sync T/Th morning to align on rollout plan. :thumbsup:
billing-bot: deploy pipeline: billing-collector v2 -> OK on canary (10%).
